meta.siteTitle: Hivemind Steward: Devin and Antigravity inside OpenCode
meta.siteDescription: An OpenCode V2 plugin. Open real Devin or Antigravity sessions in the OpenCode TUI, or let your agent delegate tasks to them.
meta.ogTagline: An OpenCode V2 plugin. Open real Devin or Antigravity sessions in the OpenCode TUI, or let your agent delegate tasks to them.

hero.support: Open a real Devin or Antigravity session in your OpenCode terminal, or let your agent hand one a task.

try.heading: Try a command
try.sideTitle: Watch it, or hand it off.
try.sideBody: Open a session when you want to watch the work and answer its questions. Delegate when you don't: the task runs in a real OpenCode child session and the result comes back to your agent.

setup.heading: Set up once.
setup.requirement: You need OpenCode V2, plus the devin CLI signed in (devin auth login) or the Antigravity ACP server. The plugin checks for them; it won't install or sign in for you.

stages.clause: After that, it stays out of your way.

keys.heading: Every key it adds.
keys.cardTitle: Devin wants to run a command
keys.caption: Permission requests show up as cards. The options come from the agent.

closing.heading: Claude Code is next.
closing.body: Cursor after that. Your support pays for the hours it takes to build them.
